_comment: Single source of truth for every tunable value. Never hardcode a threshold inside a module file - import it from here.

face_verification._note: cosine similarity above this = match. Tune against data/fixtures/faces/ pairs on Day 5.

authority_reference_match._note: cosine similarity above this = match, same convention/model as face_verification (see backend/modules/shared/face_embedding_utils.py). Starts equal to face_verification's threshold as a placeholder - tune separately once Module 5 has real reference photos in mock_db2_authority_ref.py, since comparing doc-photo-to-authority-original may tolerate a different threshold than doc-photo-to-live-selfie.

tampering_detection._dl_note: dl_probability >= high => tampered outright. <= low => clean outright. In between => borderline, consult ELA/EXIF/copy-move per tampering_detection.py fusion logic.
tampering_detection._copy_move_note: Tune min_inliers_to_flag against data/fixtures/clean/ (should stay False, even with repeated patterns like security textures) and data/fixtures/tampered/ (should flip True on genuine stamp/region duplication).

identity_reuse_detection._note: cosine similarity above this = same face flagged as reused, when paired with a DIFFERENT declared identity/doc number (see module6_blockchain/identity_reuse.py). Same convention as face_verification. Was previously hardcoded in identity_reuse.py - that file must be updated to load this value from here instead of the literal 0.6.

risk_scoring._override_note: These bypass module_weights entirely — if either fires, final_recommendation is forced to at least this band regardless of the weighted score, same non-diluting-veto principle as tampering_detection.py's DL-confident verdicts. authority_reference_match status='not_available' is NOT an override — it's neutral and should only lower evidence_strength, never raise risk_score.
